scope: Finite known producers/leases, exact owner tokens, truthful release and serialized operations assumed. Not global/native CPU or device cessation.

counterexamples.hidden_alias: retire+detach+release all known leases -> local quiet; omitted raw wrapper/native subject still calls target
counterexamples.premature_release: caller releases callback lease before CPU return -> ledger can lie; legal release order is a precondition
counterexamples.native_reverse_edge: subject removal clears its slot but observer vector can still contain subject pointers
counterexamples.reentry: inner callback release leaves outer callback token live
counterexamples.aba: same address reused with new generation/serial; old token rejected, raw pointer can still alias new object
counterexamples.native_sync_deferral: owned byte preserves value, but delayed descriptor update changes synchronous observations
counterexamples.device: all known CPU refs released does not provide SPI/DMA drain or safe LCD destruction
